bibliographic.title: Before You Leave, Lock the Door
bibliographic.author: Paper Nautilus
bibliographic.description:
A brief Twine fever dream about memory, traps, & time.
~plays in about 5 mins
~runs on a lovely minimal template designed by Lapin Lunaire
~Written for the Neo-Twiny Jam 2026, limit was 500 words of story.  My word doc has 499.
~I have tried it on mobile, seems to run fine

Controls

Open the triangle button  at bottom
</> displays Credits
Power button Restarts
Gears adjusts light/dark mode and Settings
Floppy Disc saves game
